source_refs.title: Add sites to your favorites in the new Microsoft Edge
source_refs.section: Add the current page from the address bar
source_refs.verified_excerpt: Rename the favorite (if you want to) and/or choose a different folder to save it in, and then select Done.

source_refs.section: Move a bookmark to a different folder
source_refs.applicability: Chrome on an Android phone or tablet
source_refs.verified_excerpt: Tap the folder where you want the bookmark.
